shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---docs---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---pkg version---'; node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version)\" 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo '---useTheme---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts; echo '---useThemeValue---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts; echo '---types---'; rg -n \"Theme|ThemeContextProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts -A 40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo '---ControlProps---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo '---README setup---'; sed -n '40,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export.*(Button|Text|Flex)|function Button|interface Button\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -g '*.d.ts' | head -60; echo '---Button dts---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type Theme|export.*Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo '---root pkg main/types---'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'); console.log(p.main,p.module,p.types)\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---Flex index---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---Text dts---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo '---TextBase---'; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -maxdepth 2 -iname '*Flex*' -o -iname '*Box*' | head -40; echo '---rg Flex export---'; rg -n \"Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo '---Flex index---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/index.d.ts; echo '---layout exports in components index---'; rg -n \"layout\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts; echo '---ThemeSettingsContext---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts; echo '---useThemeSettings---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts; echo '---getThemeType---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/getThemeType.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"theme/index|Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo '---components index full head---'; head -80 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo '---tail---'; tail -30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/constants.js; echo '---block/cn---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/cn.js; echo '---theme css sample---'; rg -n \"g-root_theme_dark|g-root_theme_light\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "cat CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null; echo '---AGENTS---'; cat AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; echo '---vite-env---'; cat src/vite-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---index.html---'; cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/style={{ padding: 24 }}/style={{ padding: \"var(--g-spacing-6)\" }}/' src/App.tsx && cat src/App.tsx && npm run build"
